wrongly_answered.answer: Where the RSA balance of a retiree cannot provide a monthly/quarterly pension or annuity of at least one third of the prevailing minimum wage, the retiree shall be allowed to take the entire balance in the RSA en-bloc.

wrongly_answered.question: Is it safe to keep my savings in crypto?

wrongly_answered.question: My salary has not been paid for three months. What can I do?

wrongly_answered.question: How much tax should be deducted from my monthly salary?
wrongly_answered.answer: 3.31 PFCs shall remit all tax deducted to the relevant tax authorities within 21 days following the end of month of deduction and shall also render returns of such remittances to the Commission twice yearly.

wrongly_answered.question: Can my employer deduct money from my salary for a staff loan?
wrongly_answered.answer: An employer can make all the contributions on behalf of the employee without making any deduction from the employee’s salary except that such contribution by the employer shall not be less than 20% of the monthly emoluments of the employee.

wrongly_answered.question: How do I renew my Nigerian international passport?
wrongly_answered.answer: a) International Passport or any of the following: b) National Driver's License c) Permanent Voter's Card d) National Identity Card or enrolment Slip issued by NIMC e) International Passport (mandatory for Non-Nigerians).

wrongly_answered.question: How do I change my name officially after marriage in Nigeria?
wrongly_answered.answer: i. Marriage Certificate (only applicable in the case of marriage) ii) Newspaper publication iii) Sworn affidavit (for change of name) iv) Letter of confirmation for change of name from employer (where applicable).
